ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Checking` and four copies of the region `Seat`, with `i` = 0, 1, 2 and 3. Seat 0 is already buckled, but the transitions are delayed, so nothing moves yet.
The copy with `i` = 0 sees `buckled[0]` and goes to `Fastened`. The other three keep waiting.
Seats 1 and 3 are buckled: their copies finish too, in the same tick. Only seat 2 is still open.
Everyone unbuckles, but the finished copies stay in `Fastened`: this simple chart only waits for each belt once.
Seat 2 is buckled. Now every copy is in its final state, so `Checking` terminates and `join to Ready` fires in the same tick: the chime stops.
